From diris.lambdabar Require Export langtools.

From diris.lambdabar Require Export langdef.

Module GV.

Inductive expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Fun : string -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Unit : expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | Fork : expr -> expr
  | Send : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Send' : val -> val -> expr
  | Send'' : val -> val -> expr
  | Send''' : val -> val -> expr
  | Send'''' : val -> val -> expr
  | Recv : expr -> expr
  | Close : expr -> expr
with val :=
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UnitV : val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
  | ChanV : nat -> val.

Definition subst (x:string) (a:val) := fix rec e :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => e
  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | Fun x' e => Fun x' (if decide (x = x') then e else rec e)
  | App e1 e2 => App (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Unit => Unit
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | LetPair e1 e2 => LetPair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Sum n e => Sum n (rec e)
  | MatchSum n e1 e2 => MatchSum n (rec e1) (rec ∘ e2)
  | Fork e => Fork (rec e)
  | Send e1 e2 => Send (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Send' v1 v2 => Send' v1 v2
  | Send'' v1 v2 => Send'' v1 v2
  | Send''' v1 v2 => Send''' v1 v2
  | Send'''' v1 v2 => Send'''' v1 v2
  | Recv e => Recv (rec e)
  | Close e => Close (rec e)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Fun_step x e :
    pure_step (Fun x e) (Val $ FunV x e)
  | App_step x e a :
    pure_step (App (Val $ FunV x e) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Unit_step :
    pure_step Unit (Val $ UnitV)
  | Pair_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val $ PairV v1 v2)
  | LetPair_step v1 v2 e:
    pure_step (LetPair (Val $ PairV v1 v2) e) (App (App e (Val v1)) (Val v2))
  | Sum_step n v :
    pure_step (Sum n (Val v)) (Val $ SumV n v)
  | MatchSum_step n (i : fin n) v es :
    pure_step (MatchSum n (Val $ SumV i v) es) (App (es i) (Val v))
  | Send'_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Send (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Send' v1 v2)
  | Send''_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Send' v1 v2) (Send'' v1 v2)
  | Send'''_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Send'' v1 v2) (Send''' v1 v2)
  | Send''''_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Send''' v1 v2) (Send'''' v1 v2).

Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_App_l e : ctx1 (λ x, App x e)
  | Ctx_App_r e : ctx1 (λ x, App e x)
  | Ctx_Pair_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair x e)
  | Ctx_Pair_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair e x)
  | Ctx_LetPair e : ctx1 (λ x, LetPair x e)
  | Ctx_Sum i : ctx1 (λ x, Sum i x)
  | Ctx_MatchSum n es : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSum n x es)
  | Ctx_Fork : ctx1 (λ x, Fork x)
  | Ctx_Send_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Send x e)
  | Ctx_Send_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Send e x)
  | Ctx_Recv : ctx1 (λ x, Recv x)
  | Ctx_Close : ctx1 (λ x, Close x).

Inductive ctx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_id : ctx id
  | Ctx_comp k1 k2 : ctx1 k1 -> ctx k2 -> ctx (k1 ∘ k2).

Inductive obj := Thread (e : expr) | Chan | Buf (c1 c2 : nat) (v : val) | Buf' (c1 c2 : nat) (v : val) | Buf'' (c1 c2 : nat) (v : val) | Used.

Definition cfg := gmap nat obj.

Inductive local_step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
  | Pure_step i k e e' :
    ctx k -> pure_step e e' ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k e) ]} {[ i := Thread (k e') ]}
  | Exit_step i v :
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (Val v) ]} ∅
  | Buf_done_step i :
    local_step i {[ i := Used ]} ∅
  | Fork_step i j n k v :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (Fork (Val v))) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ ChanV n));
                    j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val $ ChanV n));
                    n := Chan ]}
  | Send_step i j n k v c :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (Send'''' (ChanV c) v)) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ ChanV n));
                    j := Buf c n v;
                    n := Chan ]}
  | Buf'_step i n v c :
    local_step i {[ i := Buf c n v ]} {[ i := Buf' c n v ]}
  | Buf''_step i n v c :
    local_step i {[ i := Buf' c n v ]} {[ i := Buf'' c n v ]}
  | Recv_step i j n  k v c :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (Recv (Val $ ChanV n)));
                    j := Buf'' n c v;
                    n := Chan ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k $ Val (PairV (ChanV c) v));
                    j := Used ]}.

Inductive step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
  | Frame_step ρ ρ' ρf i :
    ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ' ##ₘ ρf ->
    local_step i ρ ρ' -> step i (ρ ∪ ρf) (ρ' ∪ ρf).

Definition step' ρ ρ' := ∃ i, step i ρ ρ'.

Definition steps := rtc step'.

End GV.

Notation Let x e1 e2 := (App (Fun x e2) e1).

Notation Let' x e1 e2 := (App (Val $ FunV x e2) e1).

Notation Let2 x y e1 e2 e3 := (App (App (Val $ FunV x (Fun y e3)) e1) e2).

Fixpoint compile (e : GV.expr) : expr :=
  match e with
  | GV.Val v => Val $ compile_val v
  | GV.Var x => Var x
  | GV.Fun x e => Fun x (compile e)
  | GV.App e1 e2 => App (compile e1) (compile e2)
  | GV.Unit => Unit
  | GV.Pair e1 e2 => Pair (compile e1) (compile e2)
  | GV.LetPair e1 e2 => LetPair (compile e1) (compile e2)
  | GV.Sum n e => Sum n (compile e)
  | GV.MatchSum n e f => MatchSum n (compile e) (compile ∘ f)
  | GV.Fork e => Fork (compile e)
  | GV.Send e1 e2 =>
      Let2 "x" "y" (compile e1) (compile e2) (
          Fork (Fun "z" (App (Var "x") (Pair (Var "z") (Var "y"))))
      )
  | GV.Send' v1 v2 =>
      Let "y" (Val $ compile_val v2) (
        Fork (Fun "z" (App (Val $ compile_val v1) (Pair (Var "z") (Var "y"))))
      )
  | GV.Send'' v1 v2 =>
      Let' "y" (Val $ compile_val v2) (
        Fork (Fun "z" (App (Val $ compile_val v1) (Pair (Var "z") (Var "y"))))
      )
  | GV.Send''' v1 v2 =>
        Fork (Fun "z" (App (Val $ compile_val v1) (Pair (Var "z") (Val $ compile_val v2))))
  | GV.Send'''' v1 v2 =>
        Fork (Val $ FunV "z" (App (Val $ compile_val v1) (Pair (Var "z") (Val $ compile_val v2))))
  | GV.Recv e => App (compile e) (Val $ UnitV)
  | GV.Close e => App (compile e) (Val $ UnitV)
  end
with compile_val (v : GV.val) : val :=
  match v with
  | GV.FunV x e => FunV x (compile e)
  | GV.UnitV => UnitV
  | GV.PairV v1 v2 => PairV (compile_val v1) (compile_val v2)
  | GV.SumV n v => SumV n (compile_val v)
  | GV.ChanV n => BarrierV n
  end.

Definition compile_obj (o : GV.obj) : obj :=
  match o with
  | GV.Thread e => Thread (compile e)
  | GV.Chan => Barrier
  | GV.Buf c n v => Thread (App (Val $ FunV "z" (App (Val $ BarrierV c) (Pair (Var "z") (Val $ compile_val v)))) (Val $ BarrierV n))
  | GV.Buf' c n v => Thread (App (Val $ BarrierV c) (Pair (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val $ compile_val v)))
  | GV.Buf'' c n v => Thread (App (Val $ BarrierV c) (Val $ PairV (BarrierV n) (compile_val v)))
  | GV.Used => Thread (Val $ UnitV)
  end.

Definition compile_cfg (ρ : GV.cfg) : cfg := compile_obj <$> ρ.

Theorem compile_step ρ ρ' i :
  GV.step i ρ ρ' -> step i (compile_cfg ρ) (compile_cfg ρ').

# A dependency directory is named after its Rocq library (for example, Metalib).
LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)
LIBRARY_FLAGS := $(foreach lib,$(LIBRARIES),-R $(lib) $(notdir $(lib)))

.PHONY: all clean
all: Makefile.coq
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq

Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile
	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

clean:

# 201 — Self-dual session calculus: operational simulation of GV

## Task

Show that one asynchronous GV step is simulated by one step between the corresponding compiled configurations.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `compile_step`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: stdpp.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.
- Work offline. Use only the supplied input and permitted local libraries. Do not look up, copy, or import an existing proof of any target.

## Deliverable

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

From diris.lambdabar Require Export langtools.

Inductive expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Fun : string -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Unit : expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | Fork : expr -> expr
with val :=
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UnitV : val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
  | BarrierV : nat -> val.

Inductive linearity := Lin | Unr.

CoInductive type :=
  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
  | UnitT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type.

CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

Definition env_split (Γ : env) (Γ1 : env) (Γ2 : env) :=
  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.

Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=
  Γ' = <[ x := t ]> Γ ∧ ∀ t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t'.

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | Var_typed Γ x t :
    env_var Γ x t ->
    typed Γ (Var x) t
  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    typed Γ' e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | App_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    env_unr Γ ->
    typed Γ Unit UnitT
  | Pair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
    typed Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | Sum_typed Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
    typed Γ e (ts i) ->
    typed Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumN_typed n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
    typed Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
    typed Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | Fork_typed Γ e t1 t2 :
    typed Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (Fork e) (FunT Lin t1 t2).

Definition subst (x:string) (a:val) := fix rec e :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => e
  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | Fun x' e => Fun x' (if decide (x = x') then e else rec e)
  | App e1 e2 => App (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Unit => Unit
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | LetPair e1 e2 => LetPair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Sum n e => Sum n (rec e)
  | MatchSum n e1 e2 => MatchSum n (rec e1) (rec ∘ e2)
  | Fork e => Fork (rec e)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Fun_step x e :
    pure_step (Fun x e) (Val $ FunV x e)
  | App_step x e a :
    pure_step (App (Val $ FunV x e) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Unit_step :
    pure_step Unit (Val $ UnitV)
  | Pair_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val $ PairV v1 v2)
  | LetPair_step v1 v2 e:
    pure_step (LetPair (Val $ PairV v1 v2) e) (App (App e (Val v1)) (Val v2))
  | Sum_step n v :
    pure_step (Sum n (Val v)) (Val $ SumV n v)
  | MatchSum_step n (i : fin n) v es :
    pure_step (MatchSum n (Val $ SumV i v) es) (App (es i) (Val v)).

Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_App_l v : ctx1 (λ x, App x (Val v))
  | Ctx_App_r e : ctx1 (λ x, App e x)
  | Ctx_Pair_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair x e)
  | Ctx_Pair_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair e x)
  | Ctx_LetPair e : ctx1 (λ x, LetPair x e)
  | Ctx_Sum i : ctx1 (λ x, Sum i x)
  | Ctx_MatchSum n es : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSum n x es)
  | Ctx_Fork : ctx1 (λ x, Fork x).

Inductive ctx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_id : ctx id
  | Ctx_comp k1 k2 : ctx1 k1 -> ctx k2 -> ctx (k1 ∘ k2).

Inductive obj := Thread (e : expr) | Barrier.

Definition cfg := gmap nat obj.

Inductive local_step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
  | Pure_step i k e e' :
    ctx k -> pure_step e e' ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k e) ]} {[ i := Thread (k e') ]}
  | Exit_step i v :
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (Val v) ]} ∅
  | Fork_step i j n k v :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (Fork (Val v))) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ BarrierV n));
                    j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val $ BarrierV n));
                    n := Barrier ]}
  | Sync_step i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k1 -> ctx k2 ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k1 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v1)));
                    j := Thread (k2 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v2)));
                    n := Barrier ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k1 $ Val v2);
                    j := Thread (k2 $ Val v1) ]}.

Inductive step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
  | Frame_step ρ ρ' ρf i :
    ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ' ##ₘ ρf ->
    local_step i ρ ρ' -> step i (ρ ∪ ρf) (ρ' ∪ ρf).

Definition step' ρ ρ' := ∃ i, step i ρ ρ'.

Definition steps := rtc step'.

  GV.step i ρ ρ' -> step i (compile_cfg ρ) (compile_cfg ρ').

Inductive ctx1 : forall _ : forall _ : expr, expr, Prop :=
    Ctx_App_l : forall v : val, ctx1 (fun x : expr => App x (Val v))
  | Ctx_App_r : forall e : expr, ctx1 (fun x : expr => App e x)
  | Ctx_Pair_l : forall e : expr, ctx1 (fun x : expr => Pair x e)
  | Ctx_Pair_r : forall e : expr, ctx1 (fun x : expr => Pair e x)
  | Ctx_LetPair : forall e : expr, ctx1 (fun x : expr => LetPair x e)
  | Ctx_Sum : forall i : nat, ctx1 (fun x : expr => Sum i x)
  | Ctx_MatchSum : forall (n : nat) (es : forall _ : Fin.t n, expr),
                   ctx1 (fun x : expr => MatchSum n x es)
  | Ctx_Fork : ctx1 (fun x : expr => Fork x).

Arguments ctx1 _%_function_scope
Arguments Ctx_App_l v
Arguments Ctx_App_r e
Arguments Ctx_Pair_l e
Arguments Ctx_Pair_r e
Arguments Ctx_LetPair e
Arguments Ctx_Sum i%_nat_scope
Arguments Ctx_MatchSum n%_nat_scope es%_function_scope
Inductive pure_step : forall (_ : expr) (_ : expr), Prop :=
    Fun_step : forall (x : string) (e : expr),
               pure_step (Fun x e) (Val (FunV x e))
  | App_step : forall (x : string) (e : expr) (a : val),
               pure_step (App (Val (FunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Unit_step : pure_step Unit (Val UnitV)
  | Pair_step : forall v1 v2 : val,
                pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val (PairV v1 v2))
  | LetPair_step : forall (v1 v2 : val) (e : expr),
                   pure_step (LetPair (Val (PairV v1 v2)) e)
                     (App (App e (Val v1)) (Val v2))
  | Sum_step : forall (n : nat) (v : val),
               pure_step (Sum n (Val v)) (Val (SumV n v))
  | MatchSum_step : forall (n : nat) (i : Fin.t n) 
                      (v : val) (es : forall _ : Fin.t n, expr),
                    pure_step
                      (MatchSum n (Val (SumV (@fin_to_nat n i) v)) es)
                      (App (es i) (Val v)).

Arguments Fun_step x%_string_scope e
Arguments App_step x%_string_scope e a
Arguments Pair_step v1 v2
Arguments LetPair_step v1 v2 e
Arguments Sum_step n%_nat_scope v
Arguments MatchSum_step n%_nat_scope i%_fin_scope v es%_function_scope
Inductive local_step : forall (_ : nat) (_ : cfg) (_ : cfg), Prop :=
    Pure_step : forall (i : nat) (k : forall _ : expr, expr) 
                  (e e' : expr) (_ : ctx k) (_ : pure_step e e'),
                local_step i
                  (@singletonM nat obj cfg
                     (@map_singleton nat obj cfg
                        (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj)
                        (@gmap_empty nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))
                     i (Thread (k e)))
                  (@singletonM nat obj cfg
                     (@map_singleton nat obj cfg
                        (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj)
                        (@gmap_empty nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))
                     i (Thread (k e')))
  | Exit_step : forall (i : nat) (v : val),
                local_step i
                  (@singletonM nat obj cfg
                     (@map_singleton nat obj cfg
                        (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj)
                        (@gmap_empty nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))
                     i (Thread (Val v)))
                  (@empty cfg (@gmap_empty nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))
  | Fork_step : forall (i j n : nat) (k : forall _ : expr, expr) 
                  (v : val) (_ : not (@eq nat i j)) 
                  (_ : not (@eq nat i n)) (_ : not (@eq nat j n)) 
                  (_ : ctx k),
                local_step i
                  (@singletonM nat obj cfg
                     (@map_singleton nat obj cfg
                        (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj)
                        (@gmap_empty nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))
                     i (Thread (k (Fork (Val v)))))
                  (@insert nat obj cfg
                     (@map_insert nat obj cfg
                        (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))
                     i (Thread (k (Val (BarrierV n))))
                     (@insert nat obj cfg
                        (@map_insert nat obj cfg
                           (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable
                              obj))
                        j (Thread (App (Val v) (Val (BarrierV n))))
                        (@singletonM nat obj cfg
                           (@map_singleton nat obj cfg
                              (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec
                                 nat_countable obj)
                              (@gmap_empty nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))
                           n Barrier)))
  | Sync_step : forall (i j n : nat) (k1 k2 : forall _ : expr, expr)
                  (v1 v2 : val) (_ : not (@eq nat i j))
                  (_ : not (@eq nat i n)) (_ : not (@eq nat j n))
                  (_ : ctx k1) (_ : ctx k2),
                local_step n
                  (@insert nat obj cfg
                     (@map_insert nat obj cfg
                        (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))
                     i (Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1))))
                     (@insert nat obj cfg
                        (@map_insert nat obj cfg
                           (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable
                              obj))
                        j (Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2))))
                        (@singletonM nat obj cfg
                           (@map_singleton nat obj cfg
                              (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec
                                 nat_countable obj)
                              (@gmap_empty nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))
                           n Barrier)))
                  (@insert nat obj cfg
                     (@map_insert nat obj cfg
                        (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))
                     i (Thread (k1 (Val v2)))
                     (@singletonM nat obj cfg
                        (@map_singleton nat obj cfg
                           (@gmap_partial_alter nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable
                              obj)
                           (@gmap_empty nat Nat.eq_dec nat_countable obj))

Lemma ctx_compile (k : GV.expr -> GV.expr) :
  GV.ctx k -> exists k' : expr -> expr, ctx k' /\ forall e, compile (k e) = k' (compile e).
Proof.

    exists (k1' ∘ k2'). split.
    + apply (ctx_comp k1' k2'); assumption.
    + intro e. cbn. rewrite Heq1. rewrite Heq2. reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF

From diris.lambdabar Require Export langtools.

Inductive expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Fun : string -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Unit : expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | Fork : expr -> expr
with val :=
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UnitV : val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
  | BarrierV : nat -> val.

Inductive linearity := Lin | Unr.

CoInductive type :=
  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
  | UnitT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type.

CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

Definition env_split (Γ : env) (Γ1 : env) (Γ2 : env) :=
  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.

Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=
  Γ' = <[ x := t ]> Γ ∧ ∀ t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t'.

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | Var_typed Γ x t :
    env_var Γ x t ->
    typed Γ (Var x) t
  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    typed Γ' e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)

| Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | Fun x' e => Fun x' (if decide (x = x') then e else rec e)
  | App e1 e2 => App (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Unit => Unit
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | LetPair e1 e2 => LetPair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Sum n e => Sum n (rec e)
  | MatchSum n e1 e2 => MatchSum n (rec e1) (rec ∘ e2)
  | Fork e => Fork (rec e)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Fun_step x e :
    pure_step (Fun x e) (Val $ FunV x e)
  | App_step x e a :
    pure_step (App (Val $ FunV x e) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Unit_step :
    pure_step Unit (Val $ UnitV)
  | Pair_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val $ PairV v1 v2)
  | LetPair_step v1 v2 e:
    pure_step (LetPair (Val $ PairV v1 v2) e) (App (App e (Val v1)) (Val v2))
  | Sum_step n v :
    pure_step (Sum n (Val v)) (Val $ SumV n v)
  | MatchSum_step n (i : fin n) v es :
    pure_step (MatchSum n (Val $ SumV i v) es) (App (es i) (Val v)).

Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_App_l v : ctx1 (λ x, App x (Val v))
  | Ctx_App_r e : ctx1 (λ x, App e x)
  | Ctx_Pair_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair x e)
  | Ctx_Pair_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair e x)
  | Ctx_LetPair e : ctx1 (λ x, LetPair x e)
  | Ctx_Sum i : ctx1 (λ x, Sum i x)
  | Ctx_MatchSum n es : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSum n x es)
  | Ctx_Fork : ctx1 (λ x, Fork x).

Inductive ctx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_id : ctx id
  | Ctx_comp k1 k2 : ctx1 k1 -> ctx k2 -> ctx (k1 ∘ k2).

Inductive obj := Thread (e : expr) | Barrier.

Definition cfg := gmap nat obj.

Inductive local_step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
  | Pure_step i k e e' :
    ctx k -> pure_step e e' ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k e) ]} {[ i := Thread (k e') ]}
  | Exit_step i v :
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (Val v) ]} ∅
  | Fork_step i j n k v :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (Fork (Val v))) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ BarrierV n));
                    j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val $ BarrierV n));
                    n := Barrier ]}
  | Sync_step i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k1 -> ctx k2 ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k1 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v1)));
                    j := Thread (k2 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v2)));
                    n := Barrier ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k1 $ Val v2);
                    j := Thread (k2 $ Val v1) ]}.

Inductive step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
  | Frame_step ρ ρ' ρf i :
    ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ' ##ₘ ρf ->
    local_step i ρ ρ' -> step i (ρ ∪ ρf) (ρ' ∪ ρf).

Definition step' ρ ρ' := ∃ i, step i ρ ρ'.

Definition steps := rtc step'.

  x = Thread (App (Fun "a" Unit) (Fun "b" Unit)) /\ i = 0.
Proof.
  intros E.
  assert (Hl : ({[i := x]} ∪ ρf) !! i = Some x) by (apply union_key).
  rewrite E, TL_eq in Hl.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [-> | Hne].
  - rewrite lookup_singleton_eq in Hl.
    injection Hl as Hl. split; [symmetry; exact Hl | reflexivity].
  - rewrite lookup_singleton_ne in Hl; [|exact Hne]. discriminate Hl.
Qed.

Lemma TR_union_key {i : nat} {x : obj} {ρf : gmap nat obj} :
  ({[i := x]} ∪ ρf) = TR ->
  x = Thread (App (Val (FunV "a" Unit)) (Fun "b" Unit)) /\ i = 0.
Proof.
  intros E.
  assert (Hl : ({[i := x]} ∪ ρf) !! i = Some x) by (apply union_key).
  rewrite E, TR_eq in Hl.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [-> | Hne].
  - rewrite lookup_singleton_eq in Hl.
    injection Hl as Hl. split; [symmetry; exact Hl | reflexivity].
  - rewrite lookup_singleton_ne in Hl; [|exact Hne]. discriminate Hl.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_fun_head k : ctx k ->
  forall e x b, k e = Fun x b -> exists x' b', e = Fun x' b'.
Proof.
  intros Hk. induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH].
  - intros e x b E. simpl in E. exists x, b. exact E.
  - intros e x b E. simpl in E.
    destruct H1; simpl in E; try discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma no_ctx_to_app k e0 :
  ctx k ->
  (forall a b, e0 <> App a b) ->
  (forall x b, e0 <> Fun x b) ->
  k e0 <> App (Fun "a" Unit) (Fun "b" Unit).
Proof.
  intros Hk Hna Hnf E.
  destruct Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2].
  - simpl in E. exact (Hna _ _ E).
  - simpl in E.
    destruct H1; simpl in E; try discriminate E.
    + injection E as Ea Eb.
      try discriminate Ea.
      try discriminate Eb.
      destruct (ctx_fun_head k2 H2 e0 "b" Unit Eb) as [x' [b' Ex]].
      exact (Hnf x' b' Ex).
Qed.

Lemma pure_step_shape k e e' :
  ctx k ->
  pure_step e e' ->
  k e = App (Fun "a" Unit) (Fun "b" Unit) ->
  k e' = App (Val (FunV "a" Unit)) (Fun "b" Unit) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hk Hp E1 E2.
  destruct Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2].
  - simpl in E1, E2. subst e. subst e'. inversion Hp.
  - simpl in E1, E2.
    destruct H1; simpl in E1, E2; try discriminate E1.
    + injection E1 as E1a E1b.
      try discriminate E1a.
      try discriminate E1b.
      rewrite E1a in E2.
      injection E2 as E2a E2b.
      discriminate E2a.
Qed.

Lemma sync_lookup (i j n : nat) (a b c : obj) :
  i <> n -> j <> n ->
  ({[i := a; j := b; n := c]} : gmap nat obj) !! n = Some c.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite lookup_insert_ne; [|congruence].
  rewrite lookup_insert_ne; [|congruence].
  rewrite lookup_singleton_eq. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma no_local_step ρ0 ρ0' ρf :
  ρ0 ##ₘ ρf -> ρ0' ##ₘ ρf ->
  ρ0 ∪ ρf = TL -> ρ0' ∪ ρf = TR ->
  local_step 0 ρ0 ρ0' -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hd Hd' E E' Hloc.
  unfold cfg in *.
  destruct Hloc as [ i k e e' Hk Hp | i v | i j n k v Hij Hin Hjn Hk | i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 Hij Hin Hjn Hk1 Hk2 ].
  - (* Pure *)
    destruct (TL_union_key E) as [Hke Hi].
    destruct (TR_union_key E') as [Hke' _].
    injection Hke as Hke. injection Hke' as Hke'.
    exact (pure_step_shape k e e' Hk Hp Hke Hke').
  - (* Exit *)
    destruct (TL_union_key (x := Thread (Val v)) E) as [Hx _].
    injection Hx as Hx. discriminate Hx.
  - (* Fork *)
    destruct (TL_union_key (x := Thread (k (Fork (Val v)))) E) as [Hx _].
    injection Hx as Hx.
    refine (no_ctx_to_app k (Fork (Val v)) Hk _ _ Hx).
    + intros a b Hc. discriminate Hc.
    + intros x b Hc. discriminate Hc.
  - (* Sync *)
    admit.
Admitted.

Lemma step_inv i ρ ρ' (H : step i ρ ρ') :
  exists ρ0 ρ0' ρf, ρ0 ##ₘ ρf /\ ρ0' ##ₘ ρf /\ local_step i ρ0 ρ0' /\ ρ = ρ0 ∪ ρf /\ ρ' = ρ0' ∪ ρf.
Proof.
  destruct H as [ρ0 ρ0' ρf Hd Hd' Hloc].
  exists ρ0, ρ0', ρf. repeat split; assumption || reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma no_target_step : ~ step 0 TL TR.
Proof.
  intros H.
  destruct (step_inv _ _ _ H) as (ρ0 & ρ0' & ρf & Hd & Hd' & Hloc & E & E').
  exfalso.
  eapply no_local_step; [exact Hd | exact Hd' | symmetry; exact E | symmetry; exact E' | exact Hloc].
Qed.
